scripts.build:dev: npx expo prebuild && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='android/gradle.properties';const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace(/^reactNativeArchitectures=.*$/m,'reactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a');fs.writeFileSync(p,s)" && npx eas build --profile development --platform android --local
scripts.build:apk: npx expo prebuild && npx eas build --profile production --platform android --local
scripts.build:android: npx expo prebuild && npx eas build --profile production --platform android
scripts.build:preview: npx expo prebuild && npx eas build --profile preview --platform android --local
scripts.build:ios: npx expo prebuild --clean && npx eas build --profile production --platform ios
